text.p: VALLETTA, Oct 4 (Reuter) The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- October 26 elections see highest number of candidates since 1981.
- Planning Authority launches incentives to encourage home owners to protect timber balconies in Vittoriosa, a four-hundred year old dockyard town in the Grand Harbour.
- Government fearful of publishing consultative report on education.

- Government defends its housing record. Says 1,000 new apartments for social accommodation will be completed in two years, but the government will no longer issue housing plots at subsidised rates because of pressures on land use.
